title: Struck by Lightning 7 Times… and Survived ⚡ #shorts
cast: a tall friendly park ranger man with a wide brimmed ranger hat, green ranger uniform and a big square jaw

lines.say: This man was struck by lightning seven times. And he survived every single one.
shots: {hero} standing on a mountain top as a huge lightning bolt strikes him, dark stormy sky, sparks everywhere
close-up of {hero} with smoking frizzy hair, looking surprised, storm clouds behind

lines.say: Roy Sullivan was a park ranger in Virginia's Shenandoah National Park.
shots: {hero} waving next to a wooden ranger station in a lush green forest valley, sunny day
wide view of rolling blue mountains and forests, a tiny ranger truck on a winding road

lines.say: In 1942, lightning hit him in a fire lookout tower and burned off his big toenail.
shots: a tall wooden fire lookout tower on a hill, lightning bolt hitting it, night storm
{hero} hopping on one foot holding his smoking boot, cartoon pain expression

lines.say: In 1969, it burned off his eyebrows. In 1970, it scorched his shoulder.
shots: {hero} driving a ranger truck on a mountain road as lightning hits the road beside it
{hero} in his front yard with a smoking shoulder, shocked face, storm overhead

lines.say: Then in 1972 and 1973, it set his hair on fire. Twice.
shots: {hero} running with his hair on fire, carrying a bucket of water, comic panic
{hero} pouring a bucket of water over his own head, steam rising

lines.say: In 1976 it hit his ankle. And in 1977, he was struck while fishing.
shots: {hero} in a small rowboat on a calm lake fishing, a lightning bolt hitting the fishing rod
{hero} sitting in the rowboat with frizzy smoking hair, holding a tiny fish, dazed

lines.say: Seven strikes, seven survivals. It earned him a Guinness World Record.
shots: {hero} holding a shiny golden trophy, confetti falling, small crowd cheering
seven glowing lightning bolts arranged in a row above {hero}, dramatic dark sky

lines.say: So was Roy the luckiest man alive, or the unluckiest? Tell me in the comments.
shots: {hero} shrugging with a big grin under a single dark rain cloud that follows only him
{hero} tipping his ranger hat, sunset behind the mountains

description:
Park ranger Roy Sullivan was struck by lightning seven times between 1942 and 1977 and survived all of them. A true story and a Guinness World Record.

Sources: Guinness World Records; Wikipedia: Roy Sullivan.

Made with AI-assisted pictures and voice.
